description: This file defines the main App component for a React application, including a custom hook to detect viewport size, a desktop-only overlay component, and routing logic. It manages display based on device width and includes environment-specific verification logic.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
methods.description: Custom React hook that detects if the viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px), updating reactively on window resize.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
methods.description: React component that displays an overlay informing the user that the application requires a desktop environment.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component that conditionally renders either the desktop-only overlay or the application routes based on viewport size and environment.
